1. Perentah ini boleh-lah di-namakan Perentah Chukai Pendapatan
(Pertadbiran Kerctapi Tanah Melayu) (Pengechualian Chukai Pem-
bangunan), 1971, dan hendak-lah di-sifatkan sa-bagai telah mula ber-
kuatkuasa bagi tahun taksiran 1969 dan tahun? taksiran kemudian-nya.

2. Pentadbiran Keretapi Tanah Melayu ada-lah dengan ini di-kechuali-
kan daripada bayaran chukai pembangunan di-bawah Bahagian III
Akta Chukai Pendapatan Tambahan, 1967 berkenaan dengan
pendapatan-nya.

Di-perbuat pada 1hb November, 1971.

INCOME TAX ACT, 1967

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 127 (3) (b) of the Income
Tax Act, 1967 read together with section 3 (1) of the Supplementary
Income Tax Act, 1967, the Minister of Finance hereby makes the
following order:

1, This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Malayan Railway
Administration) (Exemption of Development Tax) Order, 1971, and
shall be deemed to have come into force for the year of assessment 1969
and subsequent years of assessment.
